title: Permian
description: Sixth and last period of the Paleozoic Era
extract: The Permian is a geologic period and stratigraphic system which spans 47 million years, from the end of the Carboniferous Period 298.9 Ma to the beginning of the Triassic Period 251.902 Ma. It is the sixth and last period of the Paleozoic Era; the following Triassic Period belongs to the Mesozoic Era. The concept of the Permian was introduced in 1841 by geologist Sir Roderick Murchison, who named it after the region of Perm in Russia.
